assertions.text: exactly four prompt files exist, one per eval and configuration
each with_skill prompt includes the skill's full content (the note-formatter rules) and the eval's own prompt text
no baseline prompt includes any of the skill's rules text or names the skill's SKILL.md path, and each states that no skill is available
dispatch.md says each eval's with_skill and baseline agents are launched simultaneously in one launch call, not sequentially
every prompt tells the agent to save outputs under evals/note-formatter/workspace/iteration-1/eval-N/<configuration>/outputs/ and to write a timing.json there with total_tokens, duration_ms and model
